- **White slimy bacterial streaming** visible as thread-like material hanging from the cut stem end into the water below
- This is precisely the "bacterial streaming test" used to confirm bacterial vascular disease

Matching against the symptom descriptions:

This matches exactly — the cut stem in water with visible bacterial streaming, plus the brown pith discoloration visible on the stem. No other class describes this diagnostic technique.
